labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Incorrect behavior with a reproducible failure.

labels.name: type: feature
labels.description: A new user-visible capability.

labels.name: type: task
labels.description: A bounded implementation or operational task.

labels.name: type: design
labels.description: An architectural or public-contract decision.

labels.name: type: research
labels.description: Resolve uncertainty using primary sources and experiments.

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: Improve structure while preserving intended behavior.

labels.name: type: docs
labels.description: Documentation, examples, or developer guidance.

labels.name: type: test
labels.description: Tests, fault injection, or verification infrastructure.

labels.name: type: dependency
labels.description: SDK, toolchain, or automation dependency changes.

labels.name: type: security
labels.description: Public-safe security hardening; private reports use Security Advisories.

labels.name: type: maintenance
labels.description: Repository, release, or infrastructure maintenance.

labels.name: priority: p0
labels.description: Critical safety, data integrity, or availability problem; address immediately.

labels.name: priority: p1
labels.description: High impact or a prerequisite blocking the current milestone.

labels.name: priority: p2
labels.description: Normal planned work.

labels.name: priority: p3
labels.description: Lower urgency; schedule when capacity permits.

labels.name: status: triage
labels.description: Needs classification, scope, or acceptance criteria.

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Scope and prerequisites are clear; work may start.

labels.name: status: in-progress
labels.description: Actively being investigated or implemented.

labels.name: status: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until an explicit dependency or decision is resolved.

labels.name: status: needs-info
labels.description: Specific missing evidence or clarification is requested.

labels.name: area: architecture
labels.description: Responsibility boundaries, dependency direction, and system design.

labels.name: area: framework
labels.description: Public framework APIs and business orchestration mechanisms.

labels.name: area: internal
labels.description: Private process-local infrastructure and resource ownership.

labels.name: area: adapters
labels.description: Boundary adapters between framework contracts and implementations.

labels.name: area: workflows
labels.description: Workflow definitions, run modes, root/chunk/item execution.

labels.name: area: temporal
labels.description: Temporal SDK integration, workers, replay, cancellation, and Nexus.

labels.name: area: cli
labels.description: Commands, project/workflow scaffolding, and machine output.

labels.name: area: config
labels.description: Configuration layering, validation, defaults, and frozen snapshots.

labels.name: area: failure
labels.description: Shared error identity, facts, scope, rendering, and transport.

labels.name: area: i18n
labels.description: Language resources, fallback, and locale-aware presentation.

labels.name: area: control
labels.description: Control persistence, subscriptions, run registration, and progress.

labels.name: area: data-protocol
labels.description: Frozen inputs, data/reference messages, schemas, and output ownership.

labels.name: area: database
labels.description: Transactional database clients and provider-specific mechanisms.

labels.name: area: cache
labels.description: Redis/cache clients, shared state, and technical coordination.

labels.name: area: broker
labels.description: Kafka and message transport, exact records, and retention.

labels.name: area: object-store
labels.description: Object storage, immutable bundles, archives, and bounded object I/O.

labels.name: area: sql-engine
labels.description: Analytical engines, lakehouse access, and provider transactions.

labels.name: area: httpclient
labels.description: HTTP/browser providers, profiles, sessions, and transport boundaries.

labels.name: area: domain-sdk
labels.description: Domain-facing SDK integration, external accounts, and credentials.

labels.name: area: observability
labels.description: Logs, metrics, traces, health, execution summaries, and metadata projections.

labels.name: area: reporting
labels.description: Report models, rendering, notification channels, and delivery.

labels.name: area: ci
labels.description: GitHub Actions, repository checks, and automation permissions.

labels.name: area: release
labels.description: Build identity, release artifacts, deployment, and supported versions.

labels.name: area: agents
labels.description: AGENTS instructions, skills, provenance, and cross-session context.

labels.name: concern: compatibility
labels.description: API, schema, configuration, or historical-reader compatibility.

labels.name: concern: breaking-change
labels.description: Intentional incompatible change requiring an explicit migration.

labels.name: concern: determinism
labels.description: Temporal command/history or deterministic execution behavior.

labels.name: concern: concurrency
labels.description: Races, shared limits, coordination, or concurrent ownership.

labels.name: concern: lifecycle
labels.description: Initialization, cancellation, shutdown, cleanup, and resource leaks.

labels.name: concern: data-integrity
labels.description: Effect evidence, transactions, idempotency, ordering, and loss prevention.

labels.name: concern: performance
labels.description: Measured throughput, latency, memory, allocations, and capacity.

labels.name: concern: security
labels.description: Permissions, credential isolation, privacy, and trust boundaries.

labels.name: concern: developer-experience
labels.description: API clarity, diagnostics, workflow authoring, and setup usability.

labels.name: resolution: duplicate
labels.description: Covered by another linked issue.

labels.name: resolution: invalid
labels.description: The reported premise or requested behavior is not applicable.

labels.name: resolution: not-planned
labels.description: Intentionally declined or deferred outside the supported scope.
